description:
1st connection. 08-08 is the Part 8 capstone: branch -> feature add -> test -> lint -> tag -> promote to production -> TXCHECK -> rollback. Design brief (work/design/part08-design-v1.md ~214-235) says 'no new content' - this lesson mostly recombines already-confirmed mechanisms (05-12's SETENV/CRTDUPOBJ/SAVF promote-rollback pattern, part05-promote-rollback's own already-proven CRTDUPOBJ-based restore technique, 07-03's already-confirmed DSPSRVPGM DETAIL(*SIGNATURE) inspection, TXCHECK from part05-txcheck-probe). What's genuinely new and worth a connection: (1) TXCHECK has only ever been run against a synthetic self-check row (TEST01) - never against real rows for real promoted objects; (2) *PRV has only ever been applied to JUCSRV (07-03) - never to ZAISRV; (3) the specific combination of CRTDUPOBJ-promoting a *SRVPGM (not the simple *PGM 05-12/part05-promote-rollback used) through a promote-modify-repromote-rollback cycle, with TXCHECK and a DRIVER regression check confirming state at each stage.

Library scheme (advisor review): &LIB (this harness's persistent dev-role library, has JUCSRV/ZAISRV/DRIVER/ZAISRVBD from Part 7) stands in for the learner's dev library. &LIB2 ('*B', normally empty/disposable) stands in for the learner's PRODUCTION library for this connection only - NOT this harness's own real &LIB2 role elsewhere, and NOT the learner's real <USER>2 either (which in the actual curriculum is empty of JUCSRV/ZAISRV/TESTKIT until 08-08 - confirmed by grepping docs/part04-08 for '<USER>2': every hit is either 05-12's own TK0100/TK0100D promotion or this harness's own internal 実機メモ library-redaction note, never JUCSRV/ZAISRV). TESTKIT is deliberately NOT included in the promotion set (a test harness generally does not ship to production - a design decision, not an oversight). RESTOBJ is deliberately NOT attempted (matching part05-promote-rollback's own established reasoning: PUB400's RESTOBJ is undocumented in this repo's primary sources, a wrong guess would be a COMPILE-time failure in this single shared CL wrapper and lose every other step's evidence) - rollback is demonstrated via the SAME safe CRTDUPOBJ-based technique part05-promote-rollback already proved (BREAKF/BREAKP/RESTF/RESTP pattern), using a QTEMP-held baseline backup (avoiding any need for CRTDUPOBJ's unconfirmed NEWOBJ parameter - QTEMP.ZAISRV under the real, unqualified name is enough since it is a different library from &LIB2). SAVF/SAVOBJ/RESTOBJ real syntax is NOT re-tested here - 05-12's own lesson already covers it, and RESTOBJ's own real parameters remain V3/interactive-only per 02-10's established precedent; this connection only proves the CRTDUPOBJ-based mechanism actually works for a *SRVPGM end to end.

Sequence (single CL wrapper, all cl-type to preserve one job/QTEMP across every step, matching this session's established file/sh/cl/collect ordering gotcha and every other harness pitfall hit this session: no echo inside cl steps, DSPSRVPGM/DSPFD without an unconfirmed OUTPUT-incompatible parameter, no </dev/null after a pipe, file-type steps always land in &LIB never &LIB2): (1) file-deliver the NEW zaisrv.rpgle/zaisrv.bnd (solutions/08-08/*, adds pingZaisrv via a *CURRENT/*PRV binder-source split - see those files' own headers) and txckm.pf (tools/qddssrc/txckm.pf) into &LIB's source members - this does NOT touch &LIB's currently-compiled ZAISRV object yet, only the source text; (2) CRTDUPOBJ the STILL-baseline (pre-recompile) &LIB/ZAISRV to &LIB2 (production baseline) and separately to QTEMP (rollback backup, kept under the real name ZAISRV so no NEWOBJ needed); (3) CRTDUPOBJ &LIB/JUCSRV (unmodified) to &LIB2; (4) create+seed TXCKM in &LIB2 for LESSON='08-08' (JUCSRV, ZAISRV); (5) TXCHECK LESSON('08-08') LIB(&LIB2) -> expect 2 PASS; (6) DSPSRVPGM &LIB2/ZAISRV (default + DETAIL(*SIGNATURE)) -> baseline shape (3 procedures, 1 signature block); (7) NOW recompile &LIB/ZAISRV from the already-delivered new source -> &LIB's ZAISRV becomes the 4-procedure version; (8) CALL &LIB/DRIVER (dev-side regression - *LIBL finds &LIB's new ZAISRV first via the wrapper's own auto-ADDLIBLE) -> expect the same 10-line output solutions/07-05/driver.rpgle already established, proving *PRV kept DRIVER's old 3-symbol binding working; (9) DLTSRVPGM &LIB2/ZAISRV, CRTDUPOBJ the NEW &LIB/ZAISRV to &LIB2 (promote); (10) TXCHECK again -> still 2 PASS (demonstrates TXCHECK v1's own documented limitation: CHKOBJ only checks existence/type, not version - it cannot tell baseline from promoted-new apart); (11) DSPSRVPGM &LIB2/ZAISRV again -> new shape (4 procedures, 2 signature blocks) - the actual state-distinguishing check TXCHECK can't provide; (12) ADDLIBLE &LIB2 POSITION(*FIRST), CALL &LIB/DRIVER again (promoted-copy regression, proving *PRV compatibility holds in the PRODUCTION copy too, not just dev), RMVLIBLE &LIB2; (13) rollback: DLTSRVPGM &LIB2/ZAISRV, CRTDUPOBJ FROMLIB(QTEMP) TOLIB(&LIB2) (restore baseline under the real name from the QTEMP backup); (14) DSPSRVPGM &LIB2/ZAISRV -> confirms baseline shape restored (3 procedures, 1 signature block); (15) ADDLIBLE/CALL DRIVER/RMVLIBLE again (post-rollback regression); (16) cleanup &LIB2 (DLTSRVPGM ZAISRV/JUCSRV, DLTF TXCKM) so this disposable library is left empty for future probes, matching this session's established convention; (17) cleanup &LIB (DLTSRVPGM ZAISRV, CRTDUPOBJ FROMLIB(QTEMP) TOLIB(&LIB) to restore &LIB's own ZAISRV back to the 07-05 baseline, matching the 'leave shared harness state as found' discipline this session has followed throughout).

Git tag/CHANGELOG mechanics and the real SAVF/SAVOBJ/RESTOBJ walkthrough are deliberately out of scope for this connection (see above) - if time/gate budget allows, a small separate connection reusing 08-02's zaisrv-clone/zaisrv-bare.git infrastructure could cheaply confirm `git tag`+`git push origin <tag>`+`git ls-remote --tags`.

steps.label: PRECLEAN
steps.cmd:
DLTSRVPGM SRVPGM(&LIB2/ZAISRV)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
DLTSRVPGM SRVPGM(&LIB2/JUCSRV)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
DLTF FILE(&LIB2/TXCKM)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
DLTSRVPGM SRVPGM(QTEMP/ZAISRV)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)

steps.label: BASEPROM
steps.cmd: CRTDUPOBJ OBJ(ZAISRV) FROMLIB(&LIB) OBJTYPE(*SRVPGM) TOLIB(&LIB2)

steps.label: BASEBKUP
steps.cmd: CRTDUPOBJ OBJ(ZAISRV) FROMLIB(&LIB) OBJTYPE(*SRVPGM) TOLIB(QTEMP)

steps.label: JUCPROM
steps.cmd: CRTDUPOBJ OBJ(JUCSRV) FROMLIB(&LIB) OBJTYPE(*SRVPGM) TOLIB(&LIB2)

steps.label: MKTXCKM
steps.cmd: CRTPF FILE(&LIB2/TXCKM) SRCFILE(&LIB/QDDSSRC) SRCMBR(TXCKM) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: SEEDTXCKM
steps.cmd:
RUNSQL SQL('DELETE FROM &LIB2/TXCKM WHERE LESSON=''08-08''') COMMIT(*NONE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000 SQL0000)
RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB2/TXCKM VALUES (''08-08'', 1, ''JUCSRV'', ''*SRVPGM'', '' '', ''JUCSRV promoted to production'')') COMMIT(*NONE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000 SQL0000)
RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB2/TXCKM VALUES (''08-08'', 2, ''ZAISRV'', ''*SRVPGM'', '' '', ''ZAISRV promoted to production'')') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: CHKBASE
steps.cmd: TXCHECK LESSON('08-08') LIB(&LIB2)

steps.label: SIGBASE
steps.cmd:
DSPSRVPGM SRVPGM(&LIB2/ZAISRV) OUTPUT(*PRINT)
DSPSRVPGM SRVPGM(&LIB2/ZAISRV) DETAIL(*SIGNATURE) OUTPUT(*PRINT)

steps.label: RECOMPMOD
steps.cmd: CRTRPGMOD MODULE(&LIB/ZAISRV) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(ZAISRV) REPLACE(*YES) TGTCCSID(*JOB)

steps.label: RECOMPSRV
steps.cmd: CRTSRVPGM SRVPGM(&LIB/ZAISRV) MODULE(&LIB/ZAISRV) EXPORT(*SRCFILE) SRCFILE(&LIB/QSRVSRC) SRCMBR(ZAISRV) ACTGRP(*CALLER)

steps.label: DEVREGR
steps.cmd:
&LIB/TXRESET LIB(&LIB)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CALL PGM(&LIB/DRIVER)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000 MCH0000 RNQ0000 CEE0000)
&LIB/TXRESET LIB(&LIB)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)

steps.label: DELOLDPROD
steps.cmd: DLTSRVPGM SRVPGM(&LIB2/ZAISRV)

steps.label: NEWPROM
steps.cmd: CRTDUPOBJ OBJ(ZAISRV) FROMLIB(&LIB) OBJTYPE(*SRVPGM) TOLIB(&LIB2)

steps.label: CHKNEW
steps.cmd: TXCHECK LESSON('08-08') LIB(&LIB2)

steps.label: SIGNEW
steps.cmd:
DSPSRVPGM SRVPGM(&LIB2/ZAISRV) OUTPUT(*PRINT)
DSPSRVPGM SRVPGM(&LIB2/ZAISRV) DETAIL(*SIGNATURE) OUTPUT(*PRINT)

steps.label: PRODREGR
steps.cmd:
ADDLIBLE LIB(&LIB2) POSITION(*FIRST)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
&LIB/TXRESET LIB(&LIB)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CALL PGM(&LIB/DRIVER)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000 MCH0000 RNQ0000 CEE0000)
&LIB/TXRESET LIB(&LIB)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
RMVLIBLE LIB(&LIB2)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)

steps.label: DELNEWPROD
steps.cmd: DLTSRVPGM SRVPGM(&LIB2/ZAISRV)

steps.label: ROLLBACK
steps.cmd: CRTDUPOBJ OBJ(ZAISRV) FROMLIB(QTEMP) OBJTYPE(*SRVPGM) TOLIB(&LIB2)

steps.label: SIGROLL
steps.cmd:
DSPSRVPGM SRVPGM(&LIB2/ZAISRV) OUTPUT(*PRINT)
DSPSRVPGM SRVPGM(&LIB2/ZAISRV) DETAIL(*SIGNATURE) OUTPUT(*PRINT)

steps.label: ROLLREGR
steps.cmd:
ADDLIBLE LIB(&LIB2) POSITION(*FIRST)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
&LIB/TXRESET LIB(&LIB)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CALL PGM(&LIB/DRIVER)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000 MCH0000 RNQ0000 CEE0000)
&LIB/TXRESET LIB(&LIB)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
RMVLIBLE LIB(&LIB2)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)

steps.label: CLNPROD
steps.cmd:
DLTSRVPGM SRVPGM(&LIB2/ZAISRV)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
DLTSRVPGM SRVPGM(&LIB2/JUCSRV)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
DLTF FILE(&LIB2/TXCKM)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)

steps.label: CLNDEV
steps.cmd:
DLTSRVPGM SRVPGM(&LIB/ZAISRV)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CRTDUPOBJ OBJ(ZAISRV) FROMLIB(QTEMP) OBJTYPE(*SRVPGM) TOLIB(&LIB)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
